AI Video Editor Agent v1.0.0 – initial release

- Handles cloud session management, authentication, and credit system automatically.
- Provides a mapped interface between user instructions and backend API calls for streamlined workflows.
- Includes detailed error handling, common usage scenarios, and tips for best results.
